title: Rav Acha bar Abaye
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He discussed legal questions with Ravina, raising an objection in [Shabbat 4a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.4a.4-8). Where the text says, “Rav Shila said: Actually,” Hyman proposes “Ravina said,” citing Dikdukei Soferim. In [Bava Kamma 39b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.39b.18), he likewise challenges Ravina: “Granted, according to Abaye …” Hyman infers from this that he was not the son of the famous Abaye.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Shabbat prints Rav Shila. The [Dikdukei Soferim annotation](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/hF923F9uFWAC?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=PA3) records “Ravina said.” The main manuscript column there has no speaker before the reply. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=311&lang=en) records the two exchanges with Ravina.
